text:
jordan (eng): Hey @maria, quick heads up — my last two paystubs still show US withholdings only. I moved to Dublin on 2025-01-06 and filed the relocation packet + docs on the portal. I expected Irish PAYE/PRSI to kick in. Can you check?

maria (people-ops): Thanks for flagging, @jordan (eng). Can you DM me the relocation confirmation screenshot and your employee ID + last4? I’ll loop in payroll.

jordan (eng): Employee ID 8421, last4 1234. I uploaded passport + visa + relocation form on 2025-01-05 (under "relocations/jordan"). Copy of latest paystub snippet below:```
Gross: $9,200.00
Federal Tax: $1,840.00
State Tax: $0.00
Local Tax: $0.00
Net Pay: $7,360.00
Notes: No foreign withholding recorded
```

ben (payroll): @maria (people-ops) looping in — Ben from payroll here. Looks like our provider didn't receive the tax residency update. I’m opening a ticket with GlobalPayroll to switch withholding to Irish PAYE/PRSI effective 2025-01-06 and to calculate retro adjustments. Jordan, do you have a PPSN? If not, we can do a temporary code and adjust later.

global-payroll-bot: Ticket GP-6789 created by ben (payroll) — "International withholding mismatch: jordan (8421)". Priority: P2. ETA initial response: 1 business day.

sarah (eng): FWIW I moved to IE last year, payroll ran a retro catch-up in the next cycle and it showed as a separate "adjustment" line. Was painless but did get a small withholding balance for one month.

ben (payroll): Jordan — next steps: 1) confirm PPSN or confirm you want temporary placeholder, 2) confirm exact residency start (you said 2025-01-06), 3) we’ll request retro calculation and advise if there will be net shortfall or credit. We’ll also confirm how US reporting (W-2) will be affected for 2025 — might require an explanatory note for tax team. Expect an update in GP-6789 in ~48 hours.

jordan (eng): PPSN pending (app in progress) — I confirmed 2025-01-06 for residency start. Thanks, Ben. Please ping here when GP-6789 updates. :pray:

maria (people-ops): Noted. @ben (payroll) can you also confirm whether this will generate an amended W-2 or just payroll adjustments? I want to make sure benefits/tax docs are correct for 2025.

ben (payroll): Will check with GlobalPayroll and our tax advisor. High level: internal payroll adjustments show on paystubs; W-2 typically reflects year-to-date wages and withholdings, so if there's material change we may need to issue a corrected form or provide an explanatory letter. I'll include that question in GP-6789.

jordan (eng): Appreciate it — leaving my Slack on for updates.
